build.name: make (2007 C++; modern libstdc++ no longer provides <cstring>/<cstdlib> transitively -- injected through CFLAGS, no source change)
build.cmd: make -s CFLAGS='-O2 -w -include cstring -include cstdlib -include cstdio -include climits -fpermissive' 2>&1 | grep -iE '\berror' | head -5; test -x ./zchaff && echo built

notes: Oracle: agreement with minisat-2.2.0 and picosat-965 on the same two CNFs (their receipts hold the answers).
